title: Service and Module Projection
description: The projection module documentation explaining when and how graphs are narrowed.
body: Projects the whole-project graph schematify/load-graph returns (every node, every edge, every kind, per PRD §6.1 and §14.5) down to the one ServiceGraph this app's shell can currently draw — a single service's containment subtree. This narrowing is not something crates/schematify-core or the Rust dispatch owns.
